title: ChatGPT can peek at your Chrome tabs now
hook_text: ChatGPT can now read your Chrome tabs
script:
ChatGPT can now access your open Google Chrome tabs.
OpenAI updated its official Google Chrome extension to enable this integration.
You activate the feature by tagging Chrome inside the ChatGPT desktop app.
This update follows the discontinuation of the internal OpenAI Atlas browser project.
ChatGPT now scans active web pages to assist with your specific tasks.
Would you let an AI browse your private tabs?
